seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Blocks (block mode): A1/A2 y-/+4, A3 apart/A4 together mirrored; each block moves alone if target cell in [2,58], not maze {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14)}, not a marker cell (marker xy-1).
Click inactive marker -> arm (blocks->color_1 players, marker active color_11); armed A1-A4 move active marker by 4, blocked by maze/markers/players; click player -> disarm; other clicks, A5 = no-op.
Timer bars color_0 at (64-w,0) and (0,63): w=floor(3(a+1)/7), a = actions since level start (hidden, continuity-gated; fallback (7w-1)//3 or 0).
Names = type_color_rank over non-block objects sorted by (y,x), from 2 in block mode (block_left/right reserved) else 0; wall_15/hazard_8 static scenery.
Open: maze cells beyond the 3 inferred are unknown; block-vs-block collision and left/right half (wall/hazard) effects unobserved.
